    Bridge connection

    Load the bundled extension once and every open tab, its DOM buttons, and WhatsApp / Gemini / Claude / YouTube / Gmail content become live in Browser Tabs.

    1. Brave: open brave://extensions → Developer mode → “Load unpacked” → select extensions/ultron-browser-bridge/
    2. Firefox: open about:debugging → “This Firefox” → “Load Temporary Add-on” → select manifest.firefox.json
    3. The extension syncs tabs + DOM every 800 ms to POST /api/browser/sync and picks up actions on GET /api/browser/poll.
    4. Come back here — the status dot turns green within a second.

    2. Say “I want you to open Fightform” — repairs to Firefox.
    3. Say “Search F1 in YouTube”.
    4. Say “What is on my screen?”.
    5. Check the HUD: VRAM and Response Speed update live.

    Tests never open a real app; the live check above is safe.
